title: Unique scalar dictionary updates
intent: Construct a dictionary and replace its values while it has one owner.
oracle: Sum of i+1+n for i=0..n-1: n(n+1)/2+n^2.
focus: probe lines 2-6 construct and update the same dictionary; lines 8-9 consume every value.

title: Dictionary snapshot across updates
intent: Keep an alias alive across the same scalar dictionary updates and consume both versions.
focus: probe line 5 keeps the original dictionary live; line 7 mutates values; line 10 reads both versions.

title: Managed text dictionary values
intent: Insert runtime strings into a dictionary, replace each with a concatenated value, then read them.
oracle: Each entry has length 7+decimal_digits(i+n); sum (i+1) times that length. For n=4 all values have one digit, and for n=11 all have two.
focus: probe lines 4 and 6 allocate or replace managed text values inside an integer-keyed dictionary.

title: Unique Unicode text append
intent: Append a short Unicode piece repeatedly without publishing an alias.
oracle: The text has 3n codepoints; the first lambda is at index 2 for n>0. Result: 51n+2.
focus: probe lines 2-4 build Unicode text; line 5 consumes its length and search result.

title: Text snapshot across append
intent: Retain the pre-append text and consume both its original content and the extended version.
oracle: Original length=3n, new length=4n, original z index=-1, new z index=3n. Result: 300n+4n-1+3n=307n-1.
focus: probe line 5 preserves the original text across line 7 appends; line 8 observes both versions.

title: Escaping Unicode substring
intent: Return a three-codepoint substring from a helper, discard the source binding, and consume the substring.
oracle: The slice always has three codepoints and starts at character n modulo 3 of a/lambda/z. Result: 300+ord(character), giving 1255 or 422.
focus: segment line 2 returns the slice; probe lines 9-11 keep it after rebinding the source. Materialization versus sharing is to be measured.

title: Unique byte-buffer append
intent: Build a mutable buffer from runtime byte values and read its weighted checksum.
oracle: Let b_i=(17i+n) mod256 for 0<=i<3n. Result: sum (i+1)b_i.
focus: probe lines 2-4 construct and append to the buffer; lines 6-7 consume its bytes.

title: Immutable bytes snapshot across append
intent: Convert a buffer to immutable bytes, append to the buffer, and consume both versions.
oracle: The snapshot has 3n bytes b_i=(17i+n) mod256. The buffer adds 255. Result: 30000n+2 sum b_i+255.
focus: probe line 5 publishes immutable bytes; line 6 appends; lines 7-11 consume both. Copy versus shared storage is to be measured.

title: Materialized filtered list
intent: Materialize an input list and a filtered result with runtime sizes, preserving filtered order in a checksum.
oracle: The selected n values are m,m+3,...,m+3(n-1), where m=3ceil(n/3). Weighted sum: n(n+1)(m+2n-2)/2.
focus: probe lines 2-3 build the input and filtered lists; lines 5-6 read the materialized result.

title: Large nonmonotone scalar sort
intent: Sort 300+n runtime-derived integers, beyond the small-sort paths, and consume their order. Ordinary malloc scratch is a counter blindspot to check, not a measured byte claim.
oracle: Independently numerically sort the multiset {(73i+19n) mod1009 | 0<=i<300+n}, then sum its kth element times k+1. Expected values computed with Python sorted.
focus: probe line 3 sorts 304 or 311 nonmonotone integers. Source dispatch reaches core_sort.c scalar radix scratch malloc beyond 256 elements; managed counters exclude that malloc.
